speaker: alice
text: Kicking off our green segment, scientists have cracked something incredible - they're using sunlight to turn plastic waste into clean hydrogen fuel. Finally, a way to make our rubbish actually useful instead of just floating around the ocean!

speaker: charlie
text: Brilliant stuff! And speaking of cleaning up our act, researchers have developed special algae that can grab microplastics out of water like tiny magnets. The algae produce this orange-scented oil called limonene that binds to those pesky water-repelling microplastics.

speaker: alice
text: Orange-scented cleanup crew - now that's what I call making environmental action smell good! These kinds of breakthroughs give me real hope that we're getting our act together on the plastic problem.
